rationale: C06 is a highly plausible drafting template: it uses the same two-recital structure for Hawaii land previously reserved for United States military purposes, the same finding that the land is no longer needed, the same public-interest restoration to the Territory of Hawaii, and the same survey-description machinery. Its description even begins at the west corner on the south side of a named right-of-way, gives coordinates relative to a Government Survey triangulation station, and proceeds by azimuths measured clockwise from true south. C15 and C22 are also close members of the same Hawaii-restoration form, but C06 matches the child's military-purpose predicate and survey phrasing most precisely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such land is no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS such land is no longer needed by the United States for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim and materially specific statement of the factual predicate and intended administrative disposition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at the west corner of this parcel of land, and on the south side of Hawaiian Sugar Company's railroad right-of-way ... the coordinates ... referred to Government Survey triangulation station "PUOLO" ... thence running by azimuths measured clockwise from true south
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at the west corner of this parcel of land and on the south side of Prison Road, the coordinates ... referred to Government Survey triangulation station "Kawa" ... and running by azimuths measured clockwise from true south
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel survey-opening formula and identical method for defining the boundary, with only the local landmarks and measurements changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: is hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The same operative land-restoration machinery is applied to a different Hawaiian military parcel.
